summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace types in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ uses str.startswith(ref, self) (prefix test, reference as tested value); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ uses node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to return dir(self.uri). Added NamespaceMembershipTest in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, RDFS and RDF closed membership, and non-URIRef negatives. Tests were not run, per instructions; verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
